neighbours.label: an indefinite-quantity expression opening a plural noun phrase: ' of' in 'a set of' / 'a number of' / 'a series of', and ' some'
fire: The proposal was checked against a set of written criteria.
The town is served by a number of small bus companies.
Her theory rests on a series of careful field studies.
The museum also holds some remarkable early maps.
Each sample was tested with a set of standard reagents.
The valley is home to a number of rare orchids.
The book was endorsed by some of the leading historians of the period.
The software was tried on a range of older machines.
quiet: The proposal was checked against the written criteria.
The town is served by four small bus companies.
Her theory rests on those careful field studies.
The museum also holds many remarkable early maps.
Each sample was tested with the standard reagents.
The valley is home to rare orchids.
The book was endorsed by the leading historians of the period.
The software was tried on older machines.

notes: Card: ' some' x12 and ' of' x8 of the top 32, plus Chinese 一段 / 有一些 ('a stretch of', 'there are some'). Probes: 'a set of' 0.53, 'a number of' 0.30, ' some' 0.26, 'a piece of' 0.23, 'some of the' 0.14; 'the', 'three', 'many' 0.00-0.08. The + pole peaks on small counts ('a few', 'two', 'a dab of').
